nodes.label: app/layout.tsx (root layout metadata)
nodes.rationale: Renamed from .jsx because Next 16 rejects import type in .jsx. No site-wide robots (conflicts with 404 noindex); no openGraph title/description so child pages are not overwritten.

nodes.label: getSiteUrl()
nodes.rationale: Resolves origin from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL -> NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL -> VERCEL_URL -> localhost.

nodes.label: lib/seo.ts (site config single source of truth)
nodes.norm_label: lib/seo.ts (site config single source of truth)

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (breaking-changes notice)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking API/convention changes; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs before coding. Block is auto-regenerated by next dev.

nodes.label: Per-route index/noindex control
nodes.rationale: Public routes index/follow; login, signup, private playlists noindex/nofollow; 404 noindex.

nodes.label: Verification (tsc --noEmit + next build)
nodes.rationale: npm run lint unusable: Next 16 removed next lint and direct ESLint fails with circular structure error.

nodes.label: Cinema Visual Branding (clapperboard, film strip, popcorn, 3D glasses on red)
nodes.norm_label: cinema visual branding (clapperboard, film strip, popcorn, 3d glasses on red)

nodes.label: file.svg (Document Icon)
nodes.rationale: 16x16 gray (#666) outline icon of a document/page with a folded top-right corner and text lines; default asset shipped with the create-next-app starter template, likely unused by the app.

nodes.label: globe.svg (Globe Icon)
nodes.rationale: 16x16 gray (#666) outlined globe icon with latitude/longitude lines; default asset shipped by create-next-app starter template, typically used for the 'Go to nextjs.org' footer link.

nodes.label: menu.svg (Hamburger Menu Icon)
nodes.rationale: 24px Material Symbols-style hamburger icon (three horizontal bars, light gray #e3e3e3 fill for dark UI), likely used as a mobile navigation menu toggle.

nodes.label: next.svg (Next.js wordmark logo)
nodes.rationale: Default Next.js 'NEXT.js' black wordmark SVG (394x80) shipped by create-next-app scaffold; likely unused boilerplate asset.

nodes.label: window.svg (Browser Window Icon)
nodes.rationale: 16x16 gray (#666) outline icon of an application/browser window with three dots in the title bar; default asset from the create-next-app template, likely unused by the app

nodes.label: Vercel Logo (white triangle SVG)
nodes.rationale: Default Next.js scaffold asset: Vercel brand triangle in white, likely unused boilerplate

nodes.label: lib/share.ts getSharedPlaylistServer
nodes.rationale: Uses Firestore REST API (not browser SDK) to run in Node server components; 5s timeout, one retry, revalidate 60; any failure returns null so page falls back to generic metadata.

nodes.label: Server/client page split pattern
nodes.rationale: Pages needing metadata became server components wrapping existing client bodies.

nodes.label: components/seo/ogFonts.ts + static Nunito subsets
nodes.rationale: Variable Nunito.ttf unparseable by satori, so static Regular/ExtraBold latin subsets generated; they omit star and bullet glyphs.

nodes.label: api/tmdb.ts (fetchFromTMDB, TmdbError)
nodes.rationale: Renamed from .js for type-checking; TmdbError class carries HTTP status replacing ad-hoc error.status.

nodes.label: Detail page server shells (movie/[id], tv/[id])
nodes.rationale: Thin server shells with generateMetadata, generateStaticParams (50 IDs), revalidate 3600; client body not restructured for SSR.

nodes.label: SEO Layer
nodes.rationale: Per-route metadata, canonicals, robots/sitemap, JSON-LD, dynamic OG images and index/noindex controls, without moving detail pages to server-rendered data fetch.

nodes.label: Structured data (JSON-LD)
nodes.rationale: Detail JSON-LD reuses the TMDB response already available to the shell rather than fetching the detail body server-side.
